overloadPatches.semanticRole: Removes all rows of every table intersecting targetObj (a range, element, or 4D Write Pro document); does nothing if targetObj does not intersect a table.
Removes numRows row(s) from tableRef starting at rowNumber (default numRows = 1 if omitted).

constraints: With the targetObj syntax, the numRows parameter (if it were passed) is ignored; only the targetObj syntax's own tables/rows matter.
Removing all rows of a table removes the entire table.
